description: Source code for WebKitBrowser implementation, including initialization, deinitialization, request processing, event handling, and memory observation within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: MemoryObserverImpl
classes.description: Implements memory monitoring for the WebKitBrowser plugin, tracking resident, allocated, shared memory, and process activity.

methods.name: WebKitBrowser::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the WebKitBrowser plugin, setting up browser instance, event notifications, and related interfaces.

methods.name: WebKitBrowser::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications, and releases interfaces during plugin shutdown.

methods.name: WebKitBrowser::Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information; here, no additional info.

methods.name: WebKitBrowser::Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests, setting request body for POST requests.

methods.name: WebKitBrowser::Process
methods.description: Processes web requests for browser control, such as navigation, visibility, suspend/resume, and delete directory.

methods.name: WebKitBrowser::DeleteDir
methods.description: Deletes a directory at the specified path within persistent storage.

methods.name: WebKitBrowser::LoadFinished
methods.description: Handles load completion event, notifying service and triggering event.

methods.name: WebKitBrowser::LoadFailed
methods.description: Handles load failure event, notifying service.

methods.name: WebKitBrowser::URLChange
methods.description: Handles URL change events, notifying service.

methods.name: WebKitBrowser::VisibilityChange
methods.description: Handles visibility change events, notifying service.

methods.name: WebKitBrowser::PageClosure
methods.description: Handles page closure event, notifying service.

methods.name: WebKitBrowser::StateChange
methods.description: Handles browser state changes, such as suspension, and notifies service.

methods.name: WebKitBrowser::Deactivated
methods.description: Handles remote connection deactivation, triggers deactivation job.
